purpose: Illustration requirements, separate from biological measurements and renderer implementation.

anatomy: Use a continuous head–neck–trunk–tail silhouette or seamlessly joined overlapping paths. No flat cut ends at joins.
Construct the body along one continuous centreline with a smooth width envelope; taper the tail to its tip.
Coils have consistent front/back occlusion; remove hidden outlines instead of drawing seams through the body.
Use the same anatomical model for every view; a perspective change must not change proportions.
presentation: Neutral background, restrained shading, consistent line weight.
Separate full-body lateral view from expanded dorsal-hood and ventral-hood detail panels; label every view.
No scale bar unless calibrated to an explicitly selected measured specimen.
Show the species label, display state, variant scope, evidence sources and illustration status.
evidence: An unextracted trait is unknown, not absent.
Keep measured values, qualitative descriptions, reference-image observations and artistic parameters separate.
No inference from venom composition; no ML training implied.
Do not copy damaged anatomy, preservation color or restraint-induced poses into a healthy animal preset.
Reference selection does not change image acceptance decisions. Honor existing injury/deformation exclusions.
acceptance_checks: One continuous silhouette from snout to tail; no gaps, rectangular neck bases or detached head.
No visible join seams, impossible crossings or disconnected tail.
Markings clipped to the correct anatomical surface and transformed with that surface.
No eyes on the back of the head; avoid generic circular head shapes without reference support.
Directional scale texture follows body curvature; omit unresolved detail rather than invent diagnostic scale counts.
A human checks full-body and hood detail against identified, healthy living references before scientific-reference status.

requirements: Continuous cylindrical trunk; anatomical head/neck transition; gradually tapering tail.
Eye only on visible side; hood unexpanded.
Head facing away; hood below head; smoothly narrowing lower hood merges into trunk.
Single pale monocle with dark centre on rear hood; no ventral throat band on this surface.
No dorsal monocle. Pale throat and sourced throat pattern; show only anatomically visible eyes.

markings.anchor: within expanded hood below head; exact position and ring thickness await selected reference
markings.variation: Ring outline and internal spots vary; a perfect circle is not required.

variant_selection.status: select coherent references before choosing a geographic palette; do not combine unrelated regional variants

criteria: Monocle and head/neck transition clearly visible
Known orientation; no hands covering hood
Natural hood silhouette not distorted by restraint

excluded_reference_uses.reason: Results specimen has lost tail and preserved coloration. Retain as textual anatomy evidence; exclude as healthy tail/color/whole-animal pose template.

known_source_issues: 2022 revision contains inconsistent regional labels in scale-count discussion and conflicting banding wording. Do not convert these passages into pooled numeric defaults.
